summary: Nordicus Partners Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. On October 8, 2026, the company issued a $75,000 principal promissory note to AC Nordic ApS, an entity wholly owned and controlled by director Torben Jensen, making it a related-party transaction. The note is payable on demand, bears interest at the lesser of 6.0% per annum or the legal maximum, and was approved by disinterested directors with Jensen abstaining. Proceeds fund working capital; no special-situation event, change of control, or equity issuance is involved.
